name: ElevenLabs Spatial Music
move: a mint spatial-audio seed expands into a luminous sphere and warped wave field, then the camera pulls back to reveal a generated-music workflow
how: Canvas renders a deterministic radial sphere and a perspective line field whose displacement follows the sphere. The opening label contracts into a mint seed, the camera makes a slow optical push, and the sphere resolves from directional blur into focus. A music pill docks beneath it. The camera then tracks left as connector paths draw and three generation cards arrive with staggered gradient fills, ending on a balanced workflow view. DOM text remains sparse so each beat has one clear focal point.
adapt: Change the sphere palette, music prompt and workflow labels. Preserve the dark negative space, slow 1.4–2.0s focus moves and the late workflow reveal.
port: Mount a canvas and DOM overlay. Redraw the field from the shot-time proxy; use device-independent 1920×1080 coordinates. Camera motion and text/cards remain scoped DOM transforms.
caveats: No source footage is embedded; the organic sphere is shader-like Canvas 2D
ElevenLabs native sans is approximated with Atlas Grotesk/system sans
